text:
laura: PR ready: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1234 — added 'schema-light' examples for function/tool calling and a compact SDK snippet. Can reviewers scan for: correctness, link targets, and migration note wording? Thanks!
ci-bot: build passed :white_check_mark: preview at https://deploy.preview/redwood/docs/pr-1234
alex: Looking now. Quick Q: in the compact SDK snippet you use `response.output_schema` — we normally call it `response.schema` in the client. Did you intentionally rename?
laura: Oops good catch. That was from an earlier draft. I'll update to `response.schema`. Also added a short explain paragraph for 'nullable arrays' — can you validate the example handles `null` elements?
sameer: For nullable arrays, prefer explicit union in the schema: `items: { anyOf: [ {type: 'string'}, {type: 'null'} ] }` — that's what runtime expects. Example suggestion attached: ```json
{"type":"array","items":{"anyOf":[{"type":"object"},{"type":"null"}]}}
```
maria: Also flagging that the SDK snippet needs to show streaming fallback. Suggest adding a 1-line note and a tiny code branch: ```js
const res = await client.call(...);
if (res.stream) {
  for await (const chunk of res.stream) handle(chunk);
}
```
tim: Product nit: add a short line explaining when to prefer 'schema-light' vs full JSON Schema (cost vs strictness). Helps readers choose during migration.
laura: Great. I'll push edits. One more: any broken links? I saw a reference to the old 'function-calling' page — will replace with canonical '/docs/tool-calling'
alex: :eyes: spotted one more — in examples folder the filename is 'invoke-example.md' but links expect 'invoke-examples.md'. I'll fix.
ci-bot: preview updated :rocket: https://deploy.preview/redwood/docs/pr-1234?v=2
laura: Thanks all. If no objections I'll merge after the link-fix commit lands. If anyone wants to add sentences for the migration section feel free to push to the PR.
sameer: :+1: pushed small schema tweak. No other blockers from ml side.
tim: :thumbsup: Looks good to me — go ahead.
laura: Merging in ~10m unless someone flags. Appreciate the quick reviews!
